notes:
Intro: engaged via referral from solutions partner; CTO (Maya Chen) and Head of Security (Liam O'Connor) involved. Primary ask is private VPC deployment for inference serving across NA + EU with strict data residency and long-term retention for audit logs.

Call summary (2026-03-01, demo):
- Prod-like demo of hosted API + dedicated preview. Customer: interested in Private VPC for regulated lines (insurance underwriting, claims processing).
- Quote from Liam: 'No customer PII may leave EU region; audit trails must be immutable and retained for 7 years.'
- Discussed options: VPC peering vs PrivateLink; customer leans to PrivateLink/Interface endpoints for tighter control.

Security review status:
- High-level SOC2/ISO ask: Redwood to provide latest SOC2 Type II report and ISO27001 cert -> outstanding (procurement blocker).
- SSO: SAML is required for admin console access; engineering OK with SAML SSO via customer's IdP.
- KMS: must be CMEK (customer-managed) in their AWS account; require cross-account grants + key rotation policy.
- Audit logging: all inference request/response metadata (no raw PII) must be forwarded to customer's centralized logging (CloudWatch/ELK/S3). Retention 7 years; legal will confirm exact retention schedule.

Architecture fit notes (initial):
- Preferred cloud: AWS (primary), regions: eu-west-1 (data residency), us-east-1 for NA customers.
- VPC topology: private subnets for inference nodes, separate management subnet with bastion + SSM endpoint. No public IPs on nodes.
- Network pattern: interface VPC endpoints (AWS PrivateLink) for Redwood control plane interactions; egress restricted via NAT gateway for model updates only.
- Inbound: customer initiates control-plane connections over PrivateLink; minimal inbound allowed. Admin access via SAML + IP-restricted bastion (customer ops IP ranges).
- Outbound: deny-all baseline; allow specific AWS service endpoints (S3 for model/config sync) via VPC endpoints, and Redwood-managed egress only to approved S3 buckets.
- KMS integration: Redwood to accept customer-provided ARN for AWS KMS CMK; require IAM role with decrypt/encrypt grants and key grants set up prior to POC.
- Audit/export: syslog/CloudWatch subscription filter to push request logs to customer's S3 with server-side encryption using customer CMK.

POC plan:
- Scope: 4-week POC, sample workload (claims-doc reranking + FAQ chat).
- Targets: p95 latency <250ms for chat (small payloads), baseline throughput 30 req/s per model instance, 10k tokens/day initially.
- Deliverables: network diagram, IAM role templates, test VPC guide, runbook for failover and fallback to dedicated-hosted model variant.
- Start date target: 2026-04-01 (pending legal + IAM access).

Action items assigned:
- Redwood (Priya / Diego): produce VPC diagram + IAM role JSON + KMS grant steps by 2026-03-08.
- Customer (Maya / Liam): provide list of allowed egress endpoints, IP ranges for admin, legal contact for DPA by 2026-03-12.
- Legal procurement: request SOC2/ISO artifacts from Redwood (INF-3421 opened).

Risks/Notes:
- Procurement timeline likely 6-10 weeks after SOC2 artifacts are provided.
- Customer strongly prefers CMEK and no public egress for inference traffic; adds integration work for cross-account KMS.
- If PrivateLink cannot cover control-plane needs, fallback is dedicated VPC peering w/ strict route-table controls (discussion point).

Short-term ask: technical deep-dive with customer infra team to finalize 'inbound control plane' mechanism (PrivateLink vs peering) and confirm KMS grant model.
